messages:
sara: Heads-up — can we prototype a lightweight "cache offset alerts" panel in the cost dashboard? We have a handful of routes where expected cache credits dropped this week and token cost jumped. Need a quick way to detect and surface this.

kai: Scope? per-route daily only or per-tenant + route? Also what's the initial alerting threshold and how should it appear in the console?

sara: Start per-route 24h drift detection. Show expected cache-savings vs observed and the token-cost delta. Suggest: trigger if observed savings < expected savings by >20% AND delta > $25/day for that route. For UI show sparkline + top contributors.

jess: 👍 Agree on thresholds as a starting point. We should be careful about sampling — if request sampling changed, hit rates will be biased. We need a sample-corrected estimate or sample rate attached to the metric.

patrick: From telemetry side: we should emit matched_cache_key (bool) and cache_layer ("prefix"|"kv"|"response_cache") on request_events so platform can compute per-route hit rates and attribute savings. Keep it cheap (one extra tag).

ops-bot: Note: Deploy window for telemetry pipeline change scheduled 2026-03-21T02:00Z. Please gate behind feature flag `cost.cache_offset_alerts`. :gear:

kai: UI mock idea: left column sparkline expected vs observed, right column small table of top 10 routes with hit delta and `$` impact. Each route row links to traces and to per-model breakdown. Example query we'll run server-side: 

```sql
SELECT route, SUM(tokens) AS tokens, SUM(cost) AS cost, AVG(matched_cache_key::int) AS hit_rate
FROM request_events
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

jess: Also call out model_sku variant — quantized variants reduce token cost but can affect cache hit semantics (different tokenization, cache keys). We'll need to surface model_sku in the attribution so product teams see per-sku impact.

sara: Rollout plan: feature-flagged beta for 5 internal tenants (platform + two large customers) for 1 week. Tweak thresholds to reduce false positives. Pager only if a route shows >$100/day unexplained delta after correlating with sampling/rollouts.

kai: I'll add the telemetry tags + feature flag and open a PR today. ETA: EOD tomorrow for telemetry changes.

patrick: I'll reserve a UI slot in the cost dashboard and wire up the sparkline widget. Will stub server endpoint to return expected vs observed and top routes.

jess: I'll build a small eval script to backfill 30 days and run the detection logic against historical data to estimate false positive rate.

sara: Awesome — assign to @kai and @jess for now. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
